description: This file defines a Java class 'UpdateHookCommandHandler' that implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface. It handles 'UPDATE' actions for 'HOOK' entities, specifically processing commands to update hooks via the 'HookWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: UpdateHookCommandHandler
